assign.outcome:
**Every dashboard ask you made this week is on one page, and the two layout breaks it found are fixed on AI 2.**

- **The record:** [What you asked of the AI dashboards](/framework/ai2/doc/owner-asks.md). It holds 92 asks from 17–24 Sep, word for word, grouped by topic, each marked done, partly done or not done. It is linked first from the [ai2 readme](/framework/ai2/readme.md).
- **The overview fits the screen.** [/framework/ai2/overview/](/framework/ai2/overview/) now sits beside the sidebar, padded, with no giant title. Before, its first column slid under the sidebar with text at 0px. The cause was `bleed` on a page with no gutter.
- **The rail's top row fits the rail.** The "notes" word no longer spills into the card pane.
- **Nothing was clobbered.** The padding and gap of every box on /framework/ai2/, /framework/ai/, /framework/ and /framework/styles/ were compared at 1920 and 1280: zero changes. One shrink (rail-head gaps) was caught and put back before merge.

**Left:** sub-cards anywhere is being built by card-folders. Agent chat pushing the Live card down went to live-card. Card kinds and the dark session card went to content-modules. The red flag needing two clicks, unread-wall, card sizes, names and icons are all in `card.js`, which another team is rewriting now, so they need a next brief. The mic source menu and the end-of-day report are new features, not repairs.
